title: Core Glossary: Chainsaws
description: Core Glossary: Chainsaws: the working vocabulary of Chainsaws: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo. Chainsaws fell and buck: bar length sets capacity, chain sharpness sets speed, and safety gear is mandatory — chaps, helmet, boots.
definition: Core Glossary: Chainsaws — the working vocabulary of Chainsaws: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo..
key_points: Amp-hour: Battery capacity: higher Ah means longer runtime.
Brushless: Motor without wearing brushes; more efficient and longer-lived.
RPM: Revolutions per minute: the speed rating of rotating tools.
Chuck: The clamp holding a drill bit or driver bit.
Arbor: The shaft a saw blade or grinding wheel mounts on.
Kickback: The violent throw when a blade binds; the main saw hazard.
Duty cycle: How long a tool can run under load before resting.
Torque: Twisting force, measured in newton-meters or foot-pounds.
Variable speed: Trigger or dial control of tool speed for different materials.
Guard: The shield between the user and the blade, bit or wheel.
